source: Seven learning exchanges saved as one batch
lessonTheme: Reading, information and regular -er present forms
summary: Used purpose and reason with leer. Replaced ganar información with the more natural obtener información. Correctly used leo and leemos. Corrected recurring quieremos to queremos, then recalled Queremos leer. Applied the regular -er we pattern: comprender stem initially truncated, followed by correct Aprendemos español after models and correction.

observations.outcome: Correct purpose structure and leer. Supplied the more natural collocation obtener información, lowercase para and the accent. Ganar was not declared an invalid Spanish verb.
Correct complete reason sentence. Tutor subsequently introduced leo and modelled Leo para aprender.
Correct leo and obtener after models, with capitalization and accent corrections. Tutor then introduced leemos.
Correct leemos and reason structure. Repeated quieremos error was corrected to queremos; supplied ñ.
Correct immediate recall after the preceding querer correction. Tutor then taught regular -er stem + emos using leer/leemos and aprender/aprendemos.
Attempted we form but truncated the comprender stem. Explained removing only final -er: comprend + emos. Correct comprendemos has been supplied but not yet independently produced.

Correct aprendemos with the whole stem after the regular -er explanation. Aprender/aprendemos had been explicitly modelled earlier; this is immediate cued use, not an unmodelled or delayed retention test. Supplied ñ.

nextSteps: Recall comprendemos while retaining the full comprend- stem
Recheck quiero versus queremos after a gap
Use regular -er present forms with purpose and reason in a self-created sentence
assessmentNote: Successful immediate use is distinguished from supplied forms, lexical corrections and untested delayed retention.
